HOW TO PLAY

A little color.
A little calm.

  1. 1

    Drag anywhere in the scene to orbit the island.

  2. 2

    Tap a blaster on the rim to fire its color into the structure.

  3. 3

    One shot clears the whole connected cluster of that color. Big clusters score more.

  4. 4

    Clear every cube before you run out of moves. Chain clears for a combo.

Zero ads · Zero timers · Zero pressure
